[2026-09-01T20:43:45.811Z] [player] Ask why they trade out here
[2026-09-01T20:43:45.812Z] [world] "Because out here I am the only shop in the world." The trader grins at their own arithmetic. "In a settlement I am one stall among twenty. On this stretch of road I am civilization ITSELF for half a day's walk in both directions. The mark-up is not greed, it is geography." The grin softens a notch. 
"Also — and do not spread this — somebody should be out here. The road is long. A fire and a fair-enough price change what the road IS."
